notes:
- A new AniSequel launcher icon: The app icon now uses the AniSequel artwork: the full illustration sits in the adaptive foreground on a black field, with a matching monochrome A for themed icons, so the same mark fills circular, squircle and themed shapes instead of being cropped differently on each launcher.
- Discord sign-in works out of the box: A fresh install no longer asks for a Discord application ID before it can sign in. The build carries the public application 1571747436542566561 and its public key; the field still accepts another app, and clearing it stays cleared rather than silently restoring the bundled one.
